## Description

Policy page (region, CMK rotation, audio retention, transcripts, medical records, audit retention, cross-border disabled — labels are configured policy, not certifications); request queue (access, correction, deletion with legal hold, withdraw recording consent with vendor purge receipt), tamper-evident export ZIP.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Policies are configurable per hospital tenant and enforced by retention jobs.
- [ ] **AC2.** Requests track due dates and outcomes; deletion under legal hold shows "Partially fulfilled · legal hold".
- [ ] **AC3.** Exports are tamper-evident (hash manifest) and audited.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
